events.title: Tecmo Bowl Edition release — June 18
events.description: Football-themed BoBA set crossing over the classic Tecmo Bowl arcade aesthetic. Officially licensed by Koei Tecmo. Headline chase: the Touchdown Bo Jackson 1/1 on-card autograph (capturing the iconic 1989 video-game pixel-art screen), plus Touchdown Bo Jackson /34 Black Variation cards w/ gold-ink signatures. Set ships with on-card autographs only, rare inserts, chase hits, and 8-bit alternate art cards.
